title: Effect of Power on the Characteristics of Clads and Coating of 316L Steel Deposited by Laser Cladding on Vertical Walls of D2 Steel
content: Austenitic stainless steels are widely used in structural components due to their excellent resistance to corrosion and oxidation. 316L stainless steel is favored for its outstanding mechanical strength and corrosion-resistant properties, making it ideal for various applications requiring reliability in harsh environments. Its low carbon content gives it remarkable resistance to intergranular corrosion even in the as-welded state [1].
